calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-13-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of two minors.
Dept. 218, Judge Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Leticia Perez, CSR #7782.

Petitioners Elizabeth Vazquez and Guzman Damian were present in pro per as Guardians ad litem for the minors Alan Damian Vasquez and Janet Damian Vasquez, who were not present at today's hearing.
Petitioners were placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minors to Alan Damian Vazquez and Janet Damian Vazquez.

Decree Changing Names was submitted to and signed by the Court.
